blocks.label: Count every other Pokemon that faints while I am out
blocks.summary: Each time a Pokemon other than me faints while I am on the field, my faint count for this battle goes up by 1. The count resets in the next battle.
blocks.whenLabel: When I knock out a Pokemon
examples: Add one to my faint count whenever any other Pokemon faints, like Soul Harvest
feasibility: Nothing is counted when the game only previews the move
blocks.packageReason: Package (effect only), justified: the library has no counter memory, only yes/no memory (time.once-per, time.nth-use), and the count is read by PerFaintStatMultiplierAbAttr from the same private field of the holder's battle data, so the pair works together. The trigger and the one condition are separate blocks. Tier B: the gate is the single clause `victim.id !== pokemon.id`, expressed as not(side.is self) (the id comparison and the object comparison agree because every Pokemon has a unique id). 1 attr: Soul Harvest (5589 attr 0). Oddities, not fixed: (a) PostKnockOutAbAttr reaches the holder for every faint on the field, so an ally's faint and a foe's faint both count, as the Soul Harvest text says; (b) the count is stored under the Soul Harvest name in the shared battle data, so a second ability using this class would share one counter; (c) apply writes the counter and does not draw a random number.

blocks.label: Grow a stat with every faint (like Soul Harvest)
blocks.summary: My Attack goes up by 5% for every Pokemon that fainted while I was out. Example: 5% and 3 faints makes it x1.15.
blocks.whenLabel: While the game calculates one of my stats
examples: Attack, Sp. Atk and Sp. Def each go up 5% for every Pokemon that fainted, like Soul Harvest

params.label: Which stat grows
Boost for each fainted Pokemon (% of the stat, 5 = 5%)

feasibility: Only the chosen stat is changed
Nothing changes until at least one Pokemon has fainted (the count starts at 0)
blocks.packageReason: Package, justified: the multiplier is 1 + perFaint x the faint count, and the count is the private counter that FaintCountTriggerAbAttr keeps in the holder's battle data. The library has no counter to read and its multiply-stat effect is a fixed number, so the formula cannot be split further until R-B12-02 and R-B12-03 exist. Tier A: nothing to bind (the parent gets no closure). 3 attrs, all in Soul Harvest (5589): attr 1 Attack, attr 2 Sp. Atk, attr 3 Sp. Def, each 0.05 (5%). The percent shown to staff is perFaint x 100; the class keeps the fraction. Oddities, not fixed: (a) the parent `multiplier` stays 1, so code that reads it (the studio's reflection) sees 1, not the formula; (b) the multiplier is applied on every stat query, including previews and the AI; (c) the count is not capped, so a long battle can grow a stat without limit.
